links.description: Offers seasonal camping on a level hilltop below the White Horse landmark. Includes facilities, local attractions, pricing, booking form, directions and contacts.

links.title: Osmington Hill Farm Campsite
links.description: Camping and Caravanning Club site opening in May 2022. Facilities, location and contacts.

1053601.title: Owermoigne
1053601.description:
Owermoigne is a village and parish on the A352 from  Broadmayne, before leaving West Dorset,
towards  Wool in the east.

links.title: Owermoigne Open Gardens
links.description: Details of the gardens in the village which open under the Open Gardens scheme.

links.title: Owermoigne Parish Council
links.description: Administration for the village, minutes and agendas of councillors' meetings and AGM, finances, plans, notices, and contacts.

links.title: Owermoigne Village
links.description: Guide with local organisations, activities and events calendar. Includes details of the village hall, its management, newsletter, facilities, how to book, with terms, rates, contacts and social media link.

1061349.title: Pentridge
1061349.description:
Pentridge is a village, with its name derived from the Celtic for 'hill of the wild boar' on the edge of Cranborne Chase in north East Dorset.
The former civil parish, is now administered as a combined parish with  Sixpenny Handley to the west.
The east parish boundary with Hampshire at  Martin largely coincides with Bokerley Ditch, a defensive dyke
from the 1st century, where at Bockerley Junction, it is crossed by the Roman road between
Old Sarum and Badbury Rings.  The settlement of Woodyates survives off the A354.
Cranborne is directly south, and the north limits of  Wimborne St Giles include the Roman road along Ackling Dyke as it heads south south west,
separating Pentridge and  Sixpenny Handley.
The northern boundary is with the Wiltshire parish of  Bower Chalke.

1064570.title: Piddletrenthide
1064570.description:
Piddletren­thide is a linear settlement on the River Piddle as it flows south
from Alton Pancras where it rises from the surrounding downs,
This category lists websites for both West Dorset parishes of Alton Pancras and Piddletren­thide,
whereas  Buckland  Newton is over the downs to the north.
Plush is a village in a valley to the east within Piddletren­thide parish, through which a minor road
leads to the North Dorset parish of Mappowder between  Pulham and  Hazelbury Bryan.
To the west, Cerne Vale, is represented by the  Cerne Abbas category.
To the south of White Lackington, Piddlehinton is the next parish downstream,
before  Puddletown further south east.

links.title: The Poachers Inn
links.description: Family run village pub, with 21 rooms for holiday bed and breakfast accommodation, separate from the public restaurant, formed around a central courtyard. Profile, with local attractions, photo gallery, menus, booking contacts, map and brochure for download.

links.title: The Stables at Whites Dairy House
links.description: Details of self catering accommodation; with facilities for horses. FAQ, pictures of the rooms, tariff and location information an contacts at Piddlehinton.

links.title: Bankhayes
links.description: Details of five-bedroomed detached cottage on the River Piddle available for self catering holidays. Profile, facilities and gallery with local information, availability calendar, rates, contacts, directions and village location.

1064736.title: Pimperne
1064736.description:
Pimperne is a village and North Dorset parish, immediately north of Blandford Camp, north east
of  Blandford Forum parish, and east of  Stourpaine.
Pimperne village is on the A354 road to Tarrant Hinton, represented by  Tarrant Gunville is further north.
The parish of Iwerne Stepleton is to the north west, represented
by  Iwerne Minster further north.

links.title: The Anvil Inn
links.description: Seventeenth 17th century thatched village pub, offering accommodation in eight en-suite rooms. Profile, dining with menu options, bar and meal times, social media links, contacts and location.

links.title: Pimperne Parish Council
links.description: Local administration with overview of the village, councillors, their meeting records, finances, plans, events, newsletter, clubs, related links and contacts.

links.title: Pimperne C of E VC Primary School
links.description: About education upto to 12 years, policies, inspection reports, curriculum, information for parents and carers, community role, remote learning, children's weekly class content, newsletter archive, calendar and contacts.

links.title: The Old Rectory
links.description: An historical country house offering bed and breakfast accommodation.

links.title: PoshPod
links.description: Offering a professional dog grooming service.

links.title: The Benefice of Pimperne, Stourpaine and Durweston
links.description: Made up of three parishes, St Peters in Pimperne, Holy Trinity in Stourpaine and St Nicholas in Durweston.

links.title: Pimperne: St Peter
links.description: Details including services, events, news and notices.

520504.title: Poole
520504.description:
This category leads to websites for the former borough of Poole now within the unitary authority of  BCP Council.
Parts of the old borough on the north shore of Poole Harbour west of the Old Town of Poole, from Rockley Sands,
Ham Hill to Lower Hamworthy, south east of  Upton are included in the  Hamworthy category.
The Old Town of Poole is connected to Lower Hamworthy by bridges acorss the Back Water Channel in Holes Bay.
East of the Old Town is Parkstone, with Lilliput on the east shore of Poole Harbour.
From Canford Cliffs a penisula protrudes to the south west at Sandbanks where a ferry across the entrance
of Poole Harbour serves the Isle of Purbeck at  Studland.
West of Canford Cliffs, Branksome Chine forms the boundary with the old borough of  Bournemouth.
Until there are sufficient websites, those for Parkstone and Branksome are included here.
Talbot Campus of Bournemouth University is within the north east boundary of Poole, but further north is in Bournemouth,
until Bearwood further north west, where the River Stour forms the boundary between Poole and  Wimbourne Minster at Merley.
West of Broadstone, websites are included in the  Corfe Mullen category.

links.title: Branksome Park, Canford Cliffs, Sandbanks & District Community Portal
links.description: Provides community information on Branksome Park, Canford Cliffs and Sandbanks area of the town.

links.title: BCP Council
links.description: Provides information on the Borough services and tourism.

520509.title: Arts and Entertainment
520509.description: Please only include sites connected with Poole, Upton and the Lytchetts.

links.title: Barclays House Choir
links.description: 55-strong choir with a broad repertoire sponsored by the Barclays Bank Arts Council. Includes details about the choir's history and how to contact them.

links.title: Brownsea Open Air Theatre (BOAT)
links.description: The annual Shakespeare production set on The National Trust's Brownsea Island in Poole Harbour. Includes information the current years production, ticket sales and history of BOAT.

links.title: Poole History Online
links.description: Free online database of photographs, documents and data relating to the local history of the Borough of Poole.

links.title: Hot Radio 102.8
links.description: Community radio station for Poole offering rhythmic music and local information.

520510.title: Photography
520510.description: This category lists sites about taking photographs, including photographers. Sites containing photographs of the region are listed within Maps_and_Views/Photos.

links.title: Fraser Portraits
links.description: Professional photographers of all types of photo. Includes examples of previous photos taken, facilities available and contact details.

links.title: M35 Photography

520518.title: Business and Economy
520518.description: This category includes sites covering the business and economic activities of the town, including listings of most companies and industries.

520526.title: Portland
520526.description:
The Isle of Portland is a landform projecting from the Dorset coast in to the English Channel, with a lighthouse, Portland Bill,
at its southern tip; further south than Worth Matravers on the Isle of Purbeck and Niton Lighthouse on the Isle of Wight,
though Torquay is further south across Lyme Bay.
The A354 road is the only land access to Portland, via Ferry Bridge, along the tombolo from  Wyke Regis.
To the west of the tombolo, Chesil Beach is a natural shingle bank,protecting the coastline westwards to  Abbotsbury.
Portland Harbour is east of the A354, which since 1849 construction of breakwaters from the north east of the Isle at Baclava Bay,
extending north east, then north west to Ridwell on the south bank of the River Wye at  Wyemouth, encloses 520 hectares,
creating one of the largest man-made harbour in the world.
The south shore of Portland Harbour is highly developed and websites for this area, including Castletown on low ground
to Chiswell, north of the higher Verne Heath, are listed in the  Fortuneswell category.
This category lists websites for the area south of The Verne, which includes numerous Portland Stone quarries,
and sites of special scientific interest (SSSI), as well as the villages of Grove, Easton,
Weston and Southwell before the remote southern tip at Portland Bill.

1061350.title: Sixpenny Handley
1061350.description:

with  Pentridge to the east, south east of Cranborne Chase, on the north boundary of East Dorset. 
Wimborne St Giles is to the south east, and  Gussage St Michael to the south west, where the A354 road
runs north east to the north of Hampshire at Martin (represented by  Damerham ).
From the A354, the B3081 leads road traffic through Sixpenny Handley village, westwards over
Cranborne Chase to  Tollard Royal north west of the Wiltshire boundary at Michinigton Down.
South of this, within Sixpenny Handley parish, are the hamlets of Michinigton and Gussage St Andrew,
before Cashmoor, south of the A354 in Gussage St Michael parish.
West of Michinigton, the North Dorset parish of Farnham is represented by the  Tarrant Gunville category.
Sixpenny Handley parish shares Chase Wood on its northern boundary with the Wiltshire parish
of  Bower Chalke.

520339.title: South Dorset
520339.description:

Previously Portland had shared a Borough, a local government district, with  Weymouth.
Before April 2019, Purbeck District was also a local government district representing the area east and south of Poole.
There is no parish of Purbeck so websites for these localities remain grouped together in the  Isle of Purbeck category.
Both these boroughs are in the UK Parliament constituency of South Dorset.
Much of the East, North and West Districts of Dorset coincided with electoral constituencies.
One exception is the Mid Dorset and North Poole, and localities not included
in charters elsewhere for that constituency may be listed in this category.

which have merged as a residential conurbation north of the A31 into  Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole unitary authority.
The unitary authority boundary is with  Hurn directly south on Barnsfield Heath, where
Hurn Forest and Moors River are north of Bournemouth International Airport.
At the parish's south east, the A338 road separates Barnsfield Heath from the county boundary with Hampshire,
coinciding with the River Avon.
The A338 separates Avon Heath Country Park from Avon Heath Nature Reserve before a residential area to
the north of Leybrook Common, and south of Ashley and the A31.
North of the A31, the forested area of Ashley Heath separates the built-up area of the parish from  Verwood
on the Hants border further north.
Ashley Heath is connected to  Three Legged Cross to the north west, and  West Moors is directly west.
Ferndown is south of the A31 where it forks to the A347 leading south west.
Before the unitary authorities were established, St Leonards and St Ives parish was in East Dorset, but
is in the Westminster parliamentary constituency of Christchurch.
Addresses have the postcode starting BH24 after Bournemouth, yet the postal town of Ringwood in Hants.

520462.title: Stalbridge
520462.description:
Stalbridge is a small town and North Dorset parish in Blackmore Vale, south west
of  Gillingham and north west of  Sturminster Newton.

1064701.title: Stinsford
1064701.description:
Stinsford is a village on the north bank of the River Frome, east of the A35 directly north east of  Dorchester.
The West Dorset parish of Stinsford includes hamlets of Lower and Higher Bockhampton, and extends north
to  Puddletown next parish north east along the A35, with Puddletown Forest before
the parish of Tincleton directly east on the north bank of the Frome.

1064566.title: Stoke Abbott
1064566.description:
Stoke Abbott is a village and West Dorset parish south of  Broadwindsor.
To the west of the village, Lewesdon Hill is the highest point, in Dorset.
Further west, Pilsdon Pen is the second highest point
( 279 metres (915 ft) and 277-metre (909 ft) high respectively).
This category represents both the parishes of Stoke Abbott and Pilsdon.
To the north of Pilsdon, the parish of Burstock is represented by Broadwindsor,
whereas the parish of Bettiscombe directly west, at the head of
Marshwood Vale, is represented by the  Marshwood category.

520617.title: Stour Provost
520617.description:
Stour Provost is a village and North Dorset parish on the east bank of the River Stour, connected
by the B3092 road between  Marnhull in the south to  East Stour directly north.
Fifehead Magdalen is connected only by a footbridge across the Stour, and is represented
by  West Stour parish, which is approached by the A30 from East Stour.

1064737.title: Stourpaine
1064737.description:
Stourpaine is a village and North Dorset parish, immediately north west of  Blandford Forum parish,
located to the east of the River Stour, north east of  Durweston.
The parish includes the Roman fort site at Hodd Hill south of Hanford parish, south east of  Child Okeford.
The parish of Iwerne Stepleton, represented by  Iwerne Minster further north.
Pimperne is directly east.

1064702.title: Stratton
1064702.description:
Stratton is a linear settlement along the north bank of the River Frome, now bypassed by the A37 road from  Charminster.
The railway line from  Dorchester separates the village from the majority of Stratton parish, between Charminster in the Cerne Valley to the east.
The northern parish buundary is with Godmanstone, where websites are listed with  Cerne Abbas further north.
Sydling Water forms the western boundary, and flows from  Sydling St Nicholas further north.
Grimstone is a hamlet along the A37, before the next parish to the west,  Frampton.
Muckleford is a hamlet south of a bridge over the Frome, in the parish of  Bradford Peverell.

520413.title: Studland
520413.description:
This category lists websites for the parish of Studland in the north east of the  Isle of Purbeck.
The north east tip of the parish at South Haven Point, is the mouth of Poole Harbour, where
a ferry connects with Sandbanks, projecting from  Poole.
Brownsea Island, the largest island in Poole Harbour is included in this parish.
Smaller islands to the west are included in  Arne parish.
Studland village overlooks Studland Bay and the parish includes the chalk headland, Handfast Point stretching east,
with Ballard Point to the south, and Ballard Down forms the parish boundary with  Swanage further south.
The next parish west is  Corfe Castle.

1061052.description:

south bank of the River Stour, north west of  Corfe Mullen.
The A350 road leads south from  Spetisbury to  Lytchett Matravers.
The A31 bypasses south of the village from  Wimborne Minster to

520542.description:

from  Gillingham to  Child Okeford to the east.
The main town is on the north bank, and a bridge connects to the A357 road on the south bank, from  Stalbridge
in the north west to  Shillingstone to the south east towards  Blandford Forum.

520487.title: Swanage
520487.description:
Swanage is a town and parish at the eastern point of the Isle of Purbeck.
The A351 road serves the town from  Corfe Castle.
A minor road connects Swanage with  Studland to the north.

520343.title: Symondsbury
520343.description:
This category leads to websites about the parish of Symondsbury in  West Dorset.
The parish stretches through the hills north of  Chideock to include Broadoak south of the boundary at
Filford at the head of  Marshwood Vale and west of Salway Ash in the parish of  Netherbury, where
the River Simene forms the eastern parish boundary, as it flows south, east of the village of Symondsbury.
On the eastern bank, Allington parish is represented by  Bridport where the River Simene flows east, to join the River Brit.
South of Bridport town, the River Brit forms the eastern Symondsbury parish boundary, before flowing south to the harbour at  West Bay.
East of West Bay, West Cliff and Eype Mouth are within Symondsbury parish, as are the hamlets of Lower and Higher Eype.

links.title: Symondsbury Primary School
links.description: A Church of England school for children aged 5-11. Features historical overview, examples of pupils' work, information for parents, newsletter archive, contacts and location.

links.title: Symondsbury Estate
links.description: Offers self-catering holiday accommodation and commercial units for industrial, office storage or workshops. Includes information about properties and a guide to the local area.

links.title: Eype's Mouth Country Hotel
links.description: Family run seventeen bedroom hotel. Includes local attractions, details of rooms, restaurant, facilities, contacts and coastal location.

links.title: Old Bidlake Farm
links.description: Campsite offering large tents as holiday rentals. Profile with prices and facilities at Broadoak.

links.title: Highway Farm
links.description: Details of holiday cottage, studio apartment and fishing lakes.

links.title: Symondsbury Mummers' Play 1880
links.description: Online script by J.S. Udal with cast list and indexer's notes.

links.title: Symondsbury Parish Council
links.description: Official information with history of the area and Colmer's Hill, councillors and events in the area.

1061016.title: Tarrant Gunville
1061016.description:
Tarrant Gunville is a village, and North Dorset parish where the River Tarrant rises from the
Cranborne Chase hills, which separate the village from  Ashmore to the north.
A minor road through Stubhampton leads to  Iwerne Minster in the Iwerne Valley to the west.
The River Tarrant flows south through the village of Tarrant Hinton on the A354 road north east of  Pimperne.
The River Tarrant continues south, but whereas this category represents the parish of Tarrant Hinton, the
East Dorset parishes of Tarrant Launceston, Tarrant Monketon, Tarrant Rawston and Tarrant Rushton are
represented by  Tarrant Keyneston, before the river confuence with the Stour at Tarrant Crawford.
South east of the A354, websites are listed in the East Dorset parish of  Gussage St Michael.
North of the A354, the hamlets of Gussage St Andrew and Michinigton are in the East Dorset parish of  Sixpenny Handley.
Until there are separate categories, this category includes websites for the North Dorset parishes of Chettle and Farnham.

links.title: The Museum Inn
links.description: Pub with restaurant and en-suite bedrooms, catering for shooting estates of Rushmoore and Ashcombe. Describes their facilities, menus, links to local attractions link and social media, with booking contacts at Farnham.

links.title: Great Dorset Steam Fair
links.description: Publicity includes photographs from previous years, what is on this year and information about local area, based at Tarrant Hinton.

links.title: Scoop Leisure Clothing Ltd.
links.description: Garment screenprinters also offering embroidery for clothing. Includes list of items available and the price to print them and contacts at Stubhampton.

links.title: Thr Castleman
links.description: Hotel offering en-suite rooms and restaurant. Profile, menus, terms, tariff, online booking and social media links, with contacts and location at Chettle.

links.title: Farnham Parish Council
links.description: Presents council information, new and events and village history.

1061029.title: Tarrant Keyneston
1061029.description:
Tarrant Keyneston is a North Dorset parish, and village north east of Tarrant Crawford, a hamlet and parish
whose western boundary is the confuence of the River Tarrant with the Stour.
The River Tarrant flows from Tarrant Rushton the next parish to the north east.
Besides these parishes, this category lists websites for the North Dorset parishes, Tarrant Monketon and
Tarrant Launceston south of the A354 road, and east of  Blandford Forum.
Tarrant Hinton is on the A354, north east of  Pimperne, and is represented by  Tarrant Gunville
from which the River Tarrant flows south from the Cranborne Chase hills.

links.title: Launceston Farm
links.description: Georgian farmhouse sleeping up to 12, with two cottages each sleeping 2 in any combination, and room for seating 80 in a wedding breakfast and dancing. Contacts for location in the village of Tarrant Launceston.

links.title: The Langton Arms
links.description: Thatched family-owned pub, offering restaurant, bed and breakfast accommodation, beer garden and catering for functions. Includes history, details of locally sourced food, news blog, social media and booking contacts at Tarrant Monkton.

links.title: Wikipedia: Tarrant Abbey
links.description: History of the monastery from 1186 and possible site of "Camestrum", then re-founded in the thirteenth century as a Cistercian nunnery. Lists Abbesses, with references and related links for Tarrant Crawford.

links.title: Rawston Farm
links.description: Butchery and farm shop selling their produce from hand-reared Aberdeen Angus, Hereford and Rawstar milking cows, as well as local pork and chicken. Family history, recipes, tips, news blog, links to their pub, suppliers, outlets and social media, with directions, opening times and contacts at Tarrant Rawston.

links.title: OPC: The Tarrant Parishes
links.description: Online parish clerks' project presents photographs and historical information on Tarrant Crawford, Tarrant Gunville, Tarrant Hinton, Tarrant Keynston, Tarrant Rawston and Tarrant Rushton.

links.title: Keyneston Mill
links.description: The scented botanic gardens on a 50-acre working estate growing, harvestong and distilling ingredients for Parterre Fragrances. Information for visitors, their bistro, link for online sales of perfumes, contacts and location at Tarrant Crawford.

1061050.title: Thorncombe
1061050.description:
This category represents the area south of the River Axe boundary with Somerset, south of Tatworth
in  South Somerset and north of  Hawkchurch, East Devon.
The nearest town within West Dorset is  Broadwindsor directly east.
  Marshwood separates the parishes of Thorncombe and Wooton Fitzpaine to the south.

links.title: Forde Abbey and Gardens
links.description: Stately home based on a Cistercian monastery, and estate with gardens landscaped in the 18th century. Information for visitors includes history, gallery including the Mortlake Tapestries, plant nursery, PYO, summer fair, availability as a venue for weddings or filming, news blog, directions and contacts.

links.title: Thorncombe Parish
links.description: Information for village, and hamlets of Holditch, Hewood and Synderford. Includes local administration, clubs, societies, shop, worship, education, events, news and contacts.

links.title: Thorncombe Village Shop
links.description: Profile, information for visitors, products and services, cafe, post office and events. Includes volunteers, photo gallery, community support and opening times.

links.title: St Mary's Church
links.description: History, including its peel of bells, resources, services, events calendar, news blog, staff and contacts.

links.title: Thorncombe Village Trust
links.description: Historical articles, industrial relics, natural resources and walks, all with photographs. Includes newsletter archive, events, committee, constitution, meeting records and email contact.

links.title: Thorncombe Sports and Social Club
links.description: Promoting football, cricket and skittles, also offering hire for functions. Includes membership details, opening times, contacts and location south west of the village.

links.title: St Mary’s CE Primary Academy
links.description: Head of school welcome, governership, staff, policies, performance, curriculum, nursery provision, information for parents, calendar, newsletter archive, notices and contacts.

1064571.title: Thornford
1064571.description:
This category represents the area in the north of West Dorset, south west of  Sherborne
south of the River Yeo which forms the boundary of Thornford parish with Bradford Abbas.
( where websites are currently listed under Sherborne.)
The parish of Clifton Maybank separates Thornford from the county boundary, where Stoford
is in the parish of Barwick which with East Coker is in  South Somerset.
Websites for Beer Hacket parish, south of Thornford may also be listed here, whereeas those for
Ryme Intrinseca to the south west are listed in the  Yetminster category.

links.title: Friends of St Michael's Church Beer Hackett
links.description: Aiming to preserve the building and develop as a community hub for residents, presenting music events, a lottery, and oil buying syndicate. Photographs, constitution, notices and officer contacts.

links.title: Thornford Primary School
links.description: Headteacher's welcome, prospectus, Ofsted report, information on performance, policies, classes, news, contacts and location.

links.title: Kings Arms
links.description: Pub with function room and restaurant, presents photo gallery, events, drinks, meal and buffet menus, opening hours, booking contacts and social media link.

links.title: Facebook: Thornford Village Hall
links.description: Photographs, notices, contacts, location, events diary, viewer comments and related links.

links.title: Lake Autos
links.description: Car dealer offering its range of services, vehicles for sale with part exchange available, with opening times, contacts and location north east of the village.

520407.title: Three Legged Cross
520407.description:
Three Legged Cross is an expanding settlement in south of the East Dorset parish of  Verwood, north of  West Moors.
Ashley Heath to the east is in the combined parish of  St Leonards and St Ives.
This category includes websites for the west of Ashley Heath to Horton Heath.
in the parish of  Horton, which includes websites for Woodlands to the north west.

links.title: Verwood Road Evangelical Chapel
links.description: Details of Sunday services, meetings and events with links to videos and social media.

links.title: Three Legged Cross United Reformed Church
links.description: Information on services and future events.

links.title: Woolsbridge Manor Farm Caravan Park
links.description: An award-winning touring campsite, situated within the 130-acre family-run organic working farm.

links.title: Three Legged Cross: All Saints
links.description: Information on services and events plus new and notices.

links.title: Red Kite Vehicle Consultants Ltd.
links.description: Specialist conversion for minibuses and coaches, offering new and used vehicles. Profile with type approval, finance options, after sales support, driver training and accessory shop. Include opening times and contacts.

links.title: ATL
links.description: Aviation design engineering consultants. Includes products, services, links and approvals.

links.title: Renntec
links.description: Motorcycle accessories manufacture including grab rails, engine bars and sports racks. Range of products and contact details.

links.title: Tudor Distribution Services Ltd.
links.description: Leaflet and sample distribution to households in the Bournemouth BH postal areas.

links.title: Dorset Sports Cars
links.description: Offers sports and prestige car sales and service. Includes stock list, contacts and location.

links.title: Terry Case Carpet Warehouse
links.description: Flooring retailer supplying a choice of commercial and domestic carpets, laminate and vinyls, together with oriental rugs. Profile with service range, recent projects, contacts and location at Woolsbridge.

links.title: Lewis Concrete Ltd.
links.description: Specialise in producing wetcast concrete products for a range of gardening, landscaping and building needs.

links.title: Moors Valley Motorcycles Ltd.
links.description: Buy and sell used motorcycles with a large range of motorcycles in stock and nationwide delivery.

links.title: Ashley Heath Car Boot Sale
links.description: One of the largest car boots in the Dorset Area open every Sunday except bank holidays.

links.title: Old School Toller Porcorum
links.description: Offers four self-catering cottages. Includes online booking, local attractions, contact details, location map, gallery and visitors book.

links.title: Gray's Farmhouse Bed and Breakfast
links.description: Describes this accommodation with information on places to eat, local shopping, and local attractions.

links.title: Toller Porcorum
links.description: History and parish council records, plans, announcements and related links.

links.title: Colesmoor Farm
links.description: Family run 120 acres of grass stocked with sheep and cattle, offering two en-suite rooms for bed and breakfast, and glamping in their woodland retreat. Includes facilities, local attractions, suggested walk, availability calendar, contacts, access, directions and location.

links.title: Toller Porcorum Village Hall
links.description: Centrally located purpose-built venue for clubs, holding events with catering and meetings up to 150 people. Features a defibrillator, walk booklet, photo gallery, news, hiring details and contacts for management committee.

520639.title: Tolpuddle
520639.description:
Tolpuddle is a settlement on the north bank of the River Piddle, now bypassed by the A35 trunk road, from  Bere Regis to  Puddletown to the east.
The River Piddle flows from Puddletown, eastwards north of Bryantspuddle, in the combined parish of  Affpuddle and Turner Puddle.
Tolpuddle parish extends north of the A35, before Weatherby Castle, at the top of the hill separating  Milborne St Andrew.
The parish south of the Piddle and Southover Heath is Tincleton represented by  Stinsford.
Websites for the parish of Athelhampton separating Puddletown and Tolpuddle may be listed here.

links.title: Tolpuddle Martyrs Museum
links.description: Tells the tale of six labourers' arrest, trial and deportation for unionising, leading to the foundation of modern trade unionism.

links.title: OPC: Tolpuddle
links.description: Historical records with photographs and old map.

links.title: Tolpuddle Old Chapel Trust
links.description: Project aims, building history, who’s who, resources, information for supporters and visitors, events, news and contacts.

520503.title: Transport
520503.description: This category includes sites providing area transport resources for those travelling to and from, and within the county.

links.title: Getting About
links.description: A gateway to access transport information, with journey planner for people in south east dorset, from BCP Council.

links.title: Dorset Safety Camera Partnership
links.description: Promotes improvements resulting from the use of speed reduction initiatives the county.

520393.title: Travel and Tourism
520393.description:
This category leads to websites for area attractions and resources for those travelling in the county, including tourist guides, holiday accommodation (Accommodation or its sub-categories) such as Hotels, Bed and Breakfast or Self-Catering.  Listing at county level is for websites dealing with more than one location in the county.

Priority is given to listing websites in their locality category where available,
but this may mean those categories are too small to justify a Travel and Tourism
subcategory, linked from here.
By clicking the  Regional Tree View  symbol, at the end of the path, then those localities and websites will be revealed.

links.title: Visit Dorset
links.description: Official tourist information on the county's food and drink, hotels, sports, events, attractions, countryside and beaches.

links.title: Resort Dorset
links.description: A guide to what's on offer around the county's tourist destinations.

links.title: Dorset Beaches
links.description: Guide to the county's towns, villages and beaches, featuring the latest news. Includes directions, local facilities and parking information for each beach.

links.title: Dorset Travel Guide
links.description: Local’s guide to Dorset, founded by award-winning local travel writer and blogger Emily Luxton, with insider tips and recommendations to help plan the perfect trip to Dorset.

links.title: Dorset C​amper
links.description: Guide to things to do and places​ to see in Dorset.

links.title: Exploring Dorset
links.description: A local Dorset information site written by a local.

520396.title: Accommodation
520396.description:
This category leads to websites for directories, reservation services and individual sites for temporary accommodation, primarily for travellers.
Please note that there are sub-categories for hotels, self-catering and bed and breakfast.
and these are shown by clicking the  symbol.

links.title: Shorefield Holidays Ltd.
links.description: Details of holiday parks in rural setting, with facilities, information on recreation, booking and locations at Merley, St Leonards and Swanage.

520399.title: Bed and Breakfast
520399.description:
This category is intended to link to localities with numerous establishments, primarily offering a basic overnight accommodation and morning breakfast package.  Establishments with a bar and restaurant offering lunch and evening meals are generally included in the Hotels subcategories.  Websites are only listed here where the location of the establishment is not yet represented in the list of localities at the Dorset category,
where they can be seen in the  Regional Tree View [symbol].

520397.title: Hostels
520397.description: This category lists sites for hostels - establishments where nearly all facilities are shared with other guests. Rooms are dormitory style and are usually furnished with bunkbeds.

520398.title: Hotels
520398.description: This category lists sites for hotels - establishments offering a high level of service throughout the day, in addition to a wide range of facilities, such as food, entertainment and recreational activities.

links.title: F J B Hotels
links.description: Four hotels' details of the rooms, restaurants and other facilities together with pricing and contact information for Bournemouth, Poole, Wyke Regis and Portland.

520400.title: Self Catering
520400.description: This category lists sites for holiday accommodation with full kitchen facilities, rented by the day, week or month. The guests are expected to provide their own meals.

links.title: Dorset Cottage Holidays
links.description: Offers a variety of self-catering accommodation across Dorset. Includes details of each property, with contacts for offices in Corfe Castle and Weymouth.

links.title: Dorset Holiday Cottages
links.description: Directory of holiday cottages. Details, photographs and maps.

links.title: Travel Chapter: Dorset Coastal Cottages
links.description: Directory of self catering holiday accommodation within one mile of the seaside. Guide with search, contacts and social media.

links.title: Dorset Holiday Cottages
links.description: Directory with details of properties for holidays throughout the county, and social media links.

520394.title: Attractions
520394.description: The  Attractions  topic includes websites about places or facilities that commonly draw interest from visitors, that are not listed within   Arts and Entertainment  tree.

520395.title: Camping and Caravans
520395.description: This category lists sites for campsites and caravan parks.

links.title: West Dorset Leisure Holidays
links.description: Describes five caravan holiday parks on the West Dorset Heritage coastline. With information on the caravans for sale and hire, brochure request, newsletter and online booking.

520471.title: Verwood
520471.description:
Verwood is a town and East Dorset parish, on the Hampshire boundary at Ringwood Forest.
The B3081 takes road traffic from  Wimborne St Giles in the north west to the A31 at  Ashley,
where the River Avon is the boundary with  Ringwood.
The B3072 takes road traffic from the town centre south to  Three Legged Cross.
Woodlands parish directly west, is represented by the  Horton category.
Edmondsham parish is directly north west, represented by the  Cranborne category.

links.title: Verwood Concert Brass
links.description: Dedicated to introducing new brass band players into the brass band world. History, membership information, concert dates, news, and links to videos and social media.

links.title: Verwood Town Council
links.description: Official information on admnstrarion, including councillors, meeting regirds, finances, amenities, events, news blog, clubs, social media and local links.

links.title: Trinity CE VA First School
links.description: Local Christian School, students aged 4 to 9 years. Parent information and fun for kids.

links.title: Verwood Rugby Union Football Club
links.description: Latest club news, fixtures, results and team photos plus information on membership.

links.title: Frameworks Clinic
links.description: Offers chiropractic, physiotherapy and osteopathy. Profile, their Core 4 programme, after treatment information, blog, opening times with locations served, pricing and booking contacts.

links.title: Verwood Cricket Club
links.description: Club news, awards, photos, links for results, and contact information.

links.title: Verwood Church of England First School and Nursery
links.description: Key Information on the school with information for pupils, parents and learning.

links.title: Verwood & Three Legged Cross Dementia Friendly Community Association
links.description: Raises awareness about dementia in the Community to enable people to have a greater understanding of the disease.

links.title: Ocean Catering Equipment Ltd.
links.description: Offers new equipment, maintenance and repairs. Profile and services.

links.title: Baileys Electrical
links.description: TV and electrical appliance shop, offering online sales. Profile, product range, social media links and contacts.

links.title: Opus UK Binding & Foiling Ltd.
links.description: Supplier of print cover finishing equipment and wire binding machines. Profile, online catalogue, industry blog and contacts.

links.title: Homestyle Property Maintenance
links.description: Offers handyman and property maintenance services for the town and the surrounding areas. Profile, service range, gallery, testimonials, blog, social media links and contacts.

links.title: Ian W Wallace Ltd.
links.description: Specialist arts and crafts insurance intermediary. Premiums, summary of cover and proposal form included, with social media links.

links.title: Kiwi Design
links.description: Contemporary office refurbishers, specialising in office refurbishment and space planning, from mezzanine flooring to bespoke furniture design. Projects include receptions and car showrooms.

links.title: Verwood and District Potteries Trust
links.description: Information covering besom brooms, hurdles and pottery. Includes objectives, history of the heathland industries, previous exhibitions, book sales, and related links.

links.title: Verwood Anglican Church
links.description: St Michael and All Angels local Christian churches. Information on groups, news, history and links to videos and social media.

links.title: Verwood Heathland Heritage Centre
links.description: Celebrating a rare primitive pottery site in the village. Includes information about the Trust that runs the centre, the coffee shop, location and contacts.

links.title: Verwood Methodist Church
links.description: Services and preachers, prayer requests, diary and contact.

links.title: Verwood Historical Society
links.description: Local history club including details of their programme, details of their collection, family genealogy and related links.

520453.title: Wareham
520453.description:
This category represents the Dorset town of Wareham on the west extremes of Poole Harbour
through which the River Piddle flows, separating Northport and the South.
The larger River Frome flows to the south of the town having a tidal confluence with the Piddle to the east.
The Piddle flows from the combined parish of  Affpuddle and Turnerspuddle, though the parish of
Bere Regis extends to Wareham's west boundary from the north west.
Wareham is served by the A351 through  Sandford to  Wool, between which a railway also runs.
South, across the Frome, the A351 turns south east to be the major road on the Isle of Purbeck
to Swanage, via  Corfe Castle.

links.title: Wareham Golf Club
links.description: Offering an 18 hole course, tuition, pro shop, catering and room hie. Includes membership information, green fees, news feed, links for local accommodation and contacts.

links.title: Wareham Carnival
links.description: Information about this annual event including news, programme, gallery and comments. Includes details for the next carnival, events throughout the year and contacts and social media links.

520460.title: Business and Economy
520460.description: This category includes sites covering the business and economic activities of the town, including listings of most companies and industries.

links.title: Purbeck Property
links.description: Local estate agency with details of properties for sale and to let, overview of services, fees and contacts.

links.title: Michelle Abadie
links.description: Offers design for books and the web. Details about the services offered, portfolio, contacts and social media links.

links.title: Nationwide Home Innovations Ltd.
links.description: Remote control roller garage doors, sectional doors, sun awnings, blinds, canopies and shades. Property security window shutters and gates.

links.title: S&S Joinery
links.description: Offers bespoke purpose made timber and wood work, including doors, windows, stairs, furniture, kitchens, conservatories around the county.

links.title: A&D Skips
links.description: Offer skips delivered throughout the county and beyond, then arrange for the disposal of difficult and special waste. Company history, profile, services, news blog, and contacts in Worgret.

520454.title: Travel and Tourism
520454.description: This category includes sites for area attractions and resources for those travelling in the town, including tourist guides.

links.title: Wareham - Gateway to Purbeck
links.description: Local guide with information for visitors, including accommodation; self-catering cottages, guest houses and hotels.

520456.title: Accommodation
520456.description: This category includes directories, reservation services and individual sites for temporary accommodation, primarily for travellers.

520458.title: Bed and Breakfast
520458.description: This category includes sites about establishments primarily offering a basic overnight accommodation and morning breakfast package. The emphasis is on the bedroom, rather than facilities such as a bar and restaurant.

links.title: No9 Bed and Breakfast
links.description: With 2 letting bedrooms and the new No9 Cabin room situated in the garden.

520457.title: Hotels
520457.description: This category lists sites for hotels - establishments offering a high level of service throughout the day, in addition to a wide range of facilities, such as food, entertainment and recreational activities.

links.title: Priory Hotel
links.description: This hotel stands on the banks of the River Frome. Details of the accommodation, prices and services.

520459.title: Self Catering
520459.description: This category lists sites for holiday accommodation with full kitchen facilities, rented by the day, week or month. The guests are expected to provide their own meals.

links.title: Wareham Forest Lodge Retreat
links.description: Offers holiday lodges for rent. Includes details of the park, booking and contact information.

520590.title: Weather
520590.description: This category includes weather-related sites for the county.

links.title: Dorset Live Weather
links.description: Offers live reports and forecasts across the county.

520582.title: West Bay
520582.description:
West Bay, spans the mouth of the River Brit south of  Bridport on the  Jurassic Coast
between  Eype Mouth and  Burton Bradstock to the east.
West Bay village is within the parish of Bridport, but this category includes websites for Walditch, Wych, and
the rest of Bothenhampton parish, which has its western boundary along the B3157 and A35 east of Bridport,
where its northern boundary is with  Loders, then  Shipton Gorge is to the north east.

links.title: Bridport and West Dorset Golf Club
links.description: An 18 hole, cliff-top course presents hole-by-hole guide, green fees and membership information. Location overlooking Lyme Bay, south east of Wych.

links.title: Wikipedia: West Bay
links.description: Article compiled by the public on the village and harbour. Includes history, tidal defences, geology, geography and economy, with references and related links.

links.title: Pirates Day
links.description: An annual charity event in August for all the family, with Majorettes, Morris Men and Pirates O' War tug of war team.

links.title: The Station Kitchen
links.description: A family business, with a long history in hospitality and catering. Information on menus and venue hire.

links.title: Melplash Agricultural Society Show
links.description: One of the South West's premier agricultural exhibitions and held at The West Bay Show grounds.

links.title: Bothen Hill
links.description: Vegetable growers with over 150 different varieties grown on more than 15 acres, the farm is 45 acres in total.

links.title: Eypeleaze
links.description: Bed and breakfast accommodation open throughout the year and run by its owners. Details include location, contact information, blog and tariff, with links to online booking and social media.

links.title: Haddon House
links.description: Hotel information, local attractions, photo gallery, about room options with en-suite facilities, lounge and restaurant, sample menus, with links to last minute offers and social media.

links.title: West Bay
links.description: Tourist information including photographs, details of coastal walks, accommodation, fishing, deep sea diving and the seaside.

links.title: Freshwater Beach
links.description: Details of a static holiday homes located on a family site.

520337.title: West Dorset
520337.description: West Dorset was the local government district, with its council based in Dorchester, before Dorset became a unitary authority.

links.description: Plans for affordable homes for local people in Blackdown, Burstock, Drimpton, Hursey, Kittwhistle and Seaborough. Community Land Trust committee, membership, policies, updates, news and contact form.

links.title: RCHME: Inventory of the Historical Monuments in West Dorset
links.description: Indexed links to the district's parishes and image plates such as church exteriors, capitals, stained glass windows, carved stones and other architectural details.

links.title: Historic England: Miz Maze
links.description: The earthwork remains of a turf mizmaze south east of White Hall Farm.

links.title: Wikipedia: Leigh, Dorset
links.description: Page focusing on the village and civil parish in the county of Dorset.

links.title: GenUKI: Leigh
links.description: Genealogical information for the chapelry in Yetminster parish.

links.title: West Dorset Liberal Democrats
links.description: News, policies, candidates and contact details for Beaminster, Bridport, Chickerell, Dorchester, Lyme Regis, Sherborne and the surrounding parishes.

520344.title: West Moors
520344.description:
West Moors is a town, immediately north of  Ferndown, where the A31 bypass forms the parish boundary.
Moors River forms the eastern boundary with St Leonards, and the industrial area to the north is represented by the  Three Legged Cross category.
Horton is to the north west, and Holt is rirectly east, represemted by  Colehill.

links.title: West Moors Town Council
links.description: Information about councillors, meeting records, notices, local community policing information, amenities, organisations, group activities, social media and contacts.

links.title: West Moors Middle School
links.description: General information, curriculum, recomplex communication needs provision, remote learning, newsletters, contacts, class blogs, links to Ofted report and social media.

links.title: Keep Fit With Kelly
links.description: An aerobic instructor teaching unisex aerobic dance classes at Oakhurst Community First School. Gives details about the classes, news and terms.

links.title: Pinehurst Community Church
links.description: Team of elders, direction of woship, details of the weekly activities, youth and social groups, courses, blog, contacts and location.

links.title: Seychelles Travel
links.description: UK-based travel agency offering hotels, cruises and island hopping packages.

links.title: West Moors Village Surgery
links.description: Local doctors practice gives details of the medical services available, opening times and contact information.

links.title: 1st West Moors Scout Group
links.description: Details about this part of the East Dorset District of the National Scout Association. Includes history, new headquarters building, fund raising, the 100 club and contact details.

links.title: Slop Bog Guardians
links.description: A group with the aim of preserving and protecting the character of Slop Bog Local Nature Reserve. Includes details about the group, a noticeboard and information about how to contact and join them.

links.title: Envisage Dental in West Moors
links.description: Dentist practice providing information on the staff, a gallery showing treatments done, prices for treatment, registration, online appointment booking, and contact.

links.title: Brewer and Brewer Estate Agents
links.description: Residential sales and lettings. Includes company profile, property search and contacts.

links.title: SDC Self Storage Ltd.
links.description: Serving domestic and business users. Profile includes facilities, hints and tips, sizes of units, pricing, opening times and contact details.

links.title: SiTEST Ltd.
links.description: Company specialising in supply and support of equipment in both the semiconductor industry, and in cable harness and backplane production. Includes information about the products and services provided, with contact details.

the Frome further east, which has the original West Dorset boundary with  Moreton directly east.
Tincleton parish is to the north of the Frome, which is represented by  Stinsford.

520630.title: Travel and Tourism
520630.description: This category includes sites for area attractions and resources for those travelling in the town, including tourist guides.

520475.title: Wimborne St Giles
520475.description:
Wimborne St Giles is a village and East Dorset parish, spanning the source of the River Allen, south east
of  Sixpenny Handley and east of  Gussage St Michael, which with Gussage All Saints is west
of the Allen, whereas  Horton with Woodlands is on the east bank to the south.
Cranborne is directly east.

links.title: Wimborne St Giles
links.description: C of E first school and nursery with a rural catchment for 4 to 9 year old children. Includes their prospectus, details of the school's last Ofsted report, photo gallery, community and contact details.

520331.title: Winfrith Newburgh
520331.description:
East Knighton is a hamlet on the A352 from  Wool, before entering West Dorset, at  Owermoigne.
Is in the former Purbeck district parish of Winfrith Newburgh, which gives its name to a larger village
south of the A352, with a minor road leading to  Lulworth Cove, via West Lulworth.

links.title: Winfrith Newburgh & East Knighton
links.description: History of the parish, village services, information on the council, village hall, activities, clubs places to visit, and contacts.

links.title: Red Lion Hotel – Winfrith Newburgh
links.description: Family run pub offering food, real ales, takeaway, guest accommodation and campsite. Includes information on facilities, menu, pitch plan, FAQ, link to online availability and booking, with contacts.

links.title: Winfrith Village Stores
links.description: Traditional shop with post office, with zero waste centre. Includes product range, featured offers, newsletters, online sales, client account, opening times, contacts and location.

links.title: Harriet Glen Creations
links.description: Creator of equestrian and animal-themed jewellery and resin or cast bronze sculptures. Includes FAQ, events attended, online sales, postage / returns information and contacts.

links.title: Chaldon Herring Parish Council
links.description: Purpose is to provide accurate information about the village to its own residents and to everyone who visits us either in person or on the internet.

520422.title: Winterborne Stickland
520422.description:
Winterborne Stickland is a village and North Dorset parish separated from  Blandford Forum to the east by
Bryanston which is represented by  Durweston to the north east.
This category represents the River Winterborne valley, which includes parishes of Winterborne Houghton
and Winterborne Clenston down stream to Winterborne Whitechurch on the A354,
between  Blandford St Mary and  Milborne St Andrew to the south west.
The valley to the west is represented by  Milton Abbas.

links.title: Historystore Ltd.
links.description: An online supplier of Georgian, Victorian and Edwardian greeting cards, stationery, menus, placename and correspondence cards to the public and wholesale. Includes details of the product range and contact form.

links.title: Lady Bailey Caravans
links.description: Caravan and motorhome dealer offering new and used caravans, servicing and accessories. Describes its product range and includes a list of stock at Winterborne Whitechurch.

links.title: Winterborne Houghton Parish Council
links.description: Council information including minutes, events and local interest and groups.

links.title: Downview Farm
links.description: Luxury spa holiday retreat with pool and spa with a Dorset countryside setting.

links.title: Winterborne Valley and Milton Abbas Benefice
links.description: Community of 6 rural churches in North Dorset, sharing news, events, and services.

links.title: Facebook: The Crown, Winterborne Stickland
links.description: Page for the village pub.

links.title: Dorset Churches: Winterborne Clenston
links.description: Several photographs of the small early Victorian church.

links.title: The Winterbornes’ Scout Group
links.description: Information on the beavers, cubs and scouts.

links.title: Tumblins
links.description: Accommodation in a a relaxing and stylish family home with views down the Winterborne Valley to Poole Harbour and the Isle of Wight, and surrounded by tranquil gardens and wild life.

1064738.title: Winterborne Zelston
1064738.description:
Winterborne Zelston is the last parish in former North Dorset, before the River Winterborne forms the
northern boundary of Morden, and flows north east to  Sturmer Marshall, where it enters the River Stour.
Besides Winterborne Zelston, this category lists websites for parishes of Anderson and
Winterborne Kingston upstream, south east of Winterborne Whitechurch.
Winterborne Zelston is on the A31 road bypassing Sturmer Marshall in the east,
leading to  Bere Regis to the south west.

links.title: Hilltop Barn
links.description: Offers self catering or bed and breakfast options. Photo gallery of rooms and surroundings, local guide, facilities, accommodation prices, directions and booking contacts.

links.title: Lower Winterborne Parish Council
links.description: Administration for Winterborne Zelston, Winterborne Kingston, Anderson, Muston and Thomson. Records of meetings, amenities, events, news blog, related links and contacts.

links.title: The Red Post Benefice
links.description: Five Church of England parishes serving the villages of Almer, Bloxworth, Morden, Winterborne Kingston, Winterborne Zelston with Muston and Tomson. Describes individual churches, services, prayer requests, events, news, gallery and contacts.

links.title: Anderson Manor
links.description: Private family home with extensive gardens, available for group visits, and venue for film companies or professional photographers. Includes history, mediaeval church, garden features, photo gallery, visitor access and arrangements.

links.title: Abbots Court House
links.description: Country house in six acres of private land offered for exclusive corporate hire or weddings with accommodation for 22 guests. Includes venue facilities, photo gallery, virtual tour, availability calendar, link to smaller property, with contacts in Winterborne Kingston.

links.title: Winterborne Zelston Fencing Ltd.
links.description: Provides compant details, brochure and image gallery.

links.title: The Botany Bay Inne
links.description: Traditional country pub serving food seven days a week.

520345.title: Winterbourne Abbas
520345.description:
Winterborne Abbas is a village and West Dorset parish in a valley on the A35 road, 5 miles west of  Dorchester.
Winterborne Abbas is administrered as a combined parish with Winterbourne Steepleton, which has
a village to the south east, and stretches south west towards Portesham Hill, represented by the  Portesham category.
The area west of Winterborne Abbas south of the A35 is  Litton Cheney, whereas to the north of the A35 is represented by the  Askerswell category..

links.title: Winterbourne Valley First School
links.description: Detail of how to contact the school, visits and events list and online versions of school newspapers for parents and children.

links.title: Hogleaze Self Storage
links.description: Self storage storage for individuals and Dorset removal firms. Information about the services available, cost and contact details.

links.title: Hillcrest Boarding Kennels & Cattery
links.description: Information on kennels and cattery with gallery and testimonials.

links.title: Winterbourne Steepleton: St Michael
links.description: Details of services and events plus news and notices.

links.title: Winterbourne Abbas Tyre and Auto Services Ltd.
links.description: Details of services, MOTs and tyres.

links.title: Coach House Inn
links.description: Modern country bar and kitchen.

links.title: Winterbourne Abbas & Steepleton Parish Council
links.description: Council information, policy and procedure and a brief history of the Parish.

links.title: Westfield Farm Car Sales
links.description: Details of used cars. All cars are sold with a new 12 month or long MOT and service.

1064734.title: Witchampton
1064734.description:
Witchampto­n is a village, and East Dorset parish, on the west bank of the River Allen,
south of Moor Crichel, and  Gussage All Saints.
Downstream, Pamphill is represented by  Shapwick further south west.
Across the Allen to the east, Hinton is represented by  Colehill, then upstream
Chalbury and Woodlands are represented by  Horton.

links.title: Wikipedia: Moor Crichel
links.description: Article explaining the merger with Long Crichel, and the relocation of the village, the original being submerged under the lake of Crichel House, with many residents moved to Witchampton. History, demography, references and related links.

links.title: Vale of Allen Parish Council: Witchampton
links.description: Local administration for communities along the River Allen presenting meeting records, policies, finances, planning, youth award scheme, news blog and contacts.

links.title: Witchampton CofE First School
links.description: Provides key information plus news, events and dates.

links.title: Little Owls
links.description: Preschool and nursery, an inspirational concept providing learning opportunities through practical activities in an outdoor environment.

links.title: Facebook: Witchampton Club
links.description: Lists events for this private members club.

links.title: Witchampton Cricket Club
links.description: Has two Saturday teams, two midweek teams and a Sunday team. Playing home games at Crichel Park.

links.title: OPC: Witchampton
links.description: Information on the village with genealogical links.

links.title: Wimborne Minster: Witchampton
links.description: Information on the village church with photographs.

520402.title: Wool
520402.description:
Wool is a village and parish, at the western edge of the former Purbeck district,
on the A352 from  Wareham, before entering West Dorset, at  Owermoigne.
Wool parish includes East Burton and Dorset Innovation Park to the west before
Redbridge in the parish of  Crossways to the west.
The area to the south, Coombe Keynes and east south of the River Frome is
represented by the  East Stoke category.

links.title: Fingle Bridge
links.description: Bed and breakfast accommodation situated in the village. Includes information about the accommodation available and contact details.

links.title: Whitemead Caravan Park
links.description: Tourer services supplied, photos of the area, tariff, online booking form, map, contacts and social media links.

links.title: Breachfield B&B
links.description: Bed and breakfast accommodation, with facilities, photos, rates, directions and location.

links.title: The Tank Museum
links.description: Information on the attractions, education facilities, events and exhibits at the UK's largest collection of tanks and armoured fighting vehicles at Bovington Camp.

links.title: Wool & Bovington Motors Ltd.
links.description: Ford dealer offering new and used cars. Profile, vehicles, rapid fit, service department, and contacts.

links.title: Facebook: ESWCC
links.description: East Stoke and Wool Community Chest's sponsored projects and information about grant applications.

1061049.title: Wootton Fitzpaine
1061049.description:
This category represents the area of West Dorset on the boundary with East Devon north of 
Lyme Regis,  Charmouth and Catherston Leweston.
The parish of Wootton Fitzpaine includes Monkton Wyld, on the boundary with Raymond's Hill
to the west, to its most westerly point north of  Uplyme, east of  Axminster
and south of  Hawkchurch.
Fishpond Bottom is on the north edge of Wootton Fitzpaine parish, whereas 
Marshwood parish represents websites for further north east.
The next parish to the east is Whitchurch Canonicorum, which is represented by the  Morcombelake category.

links.title: Brigs Farm Camping
links.description: Campsite with compost toilets and free showers, allowing well behaved dogs, with glamping options. Profile with photo gallery, booking calendar, pricing, contacts and location.

520484.title: Worth Matravers
520484.description:
Worth Matravers is a village and most southerly parish on the Isle of Purbeck,
which is separated by Langton Matravers from  Swanage to the east.
Worth Matravers parish stretches inland to include Herman's Cross, whereas
Kingston is an inland village to the west in the parish of  Corfe Castle.
Corfe Castle parish stretches to the south coast before  Kimmeridge, the next parish to the west.
This category lists websites for the south coast
between Egmont Point and Durston Nature Reserve.

links.title: Worth Matravers Parish Council
links.description: Administration of Harmans Cross south to St Albans Head. Includes history, map, activities, wedding venues, local businesses, councillor meetings, finances, plans, notices, contacts for MP and parish clerk.

links.title: Worth Matravers Village Hall
links.description: Focal point for village events, functions, gatherings on the village green and for hire for weddings, parties, exhibitions and meetings.

links.title: Janine Drayson
links.description: Pen and watercolour paintings inspired by nature and time spent exploring the beautiful Dorset coast and countryside.

links.title: The English Stamp Company
links.description: Makers of rubber stamps offering mail-order catalogue online.

links.title: The Square & Compass
links.description: Public house containing a small fossil museum. Overview with photographs.

1061036.title: Wyke Regis
1061036.description:
This category represents the southern tip of  Weymouth to Ferry Bridge, before
the  Fortuneswell area of the  Isle of Portland.
The sea front to the west is into The Fleet, protected on the west by  Chesil Beach.
To the east, Portland Harbour, includes the remains of Sandsfoot Castle at Castle Cove.
Websites identifying as Southlands or Rodwell with their coastline within Portland Harbour,
south of the mouth of the River Wey may be listed here.
Websites for Charlestown to the north west should be listed in the  Chickerell category.

links.title: Weymouth and Portland Cruising Association
links.description: Informal sailing / motor boat club. Details of meetings, events, forum, resources and moorings are located in the north east of Portland Harbour near those of Castle Cove Sailing Club.

links.title: Dowsett Motors Ltd.
links.description: Used car dealers, specialising in fleet managed company cars. Includes online stock list, location and contacts.

links.title: Crab House Café
links.description: Dishes cooked to order and all fish is caught locally. Menu, wine list, opening times, social media links, table bookings, contacts situated overlooking the Fleet, north of Ferry Bridge.

links.title: Chesil Bait 'n' Tackle
links.description: Specialists in lure fishing also offer equipment and bait for rock, beach, boat and slow jig, present links to videos and social media. Product range includes prices and online sales.

520589.title: Yetminster
520589.description:
Yetminster is a town, south east of  Yeovil, separated from the A37 by the West Dorset parish of Ryme Intrinseca.
This category represents both parishes, whereas the parish of Beer Hacket to the north east is represented by the  Thornford category.
Yetminster railway station is to the east of the town, where the road leads to the parish of Holnest
before  Glanviles Wootton.
The parish of  Chetnole is directly south.

links.title: Moviola
links.description: A mobile cinema based in an articulated lorry touring over 320 community venues throughout the country. Includes a 'what's on', information about the films and venues where they can be seen.

links.title: Yetminster Health Centre
links.description: General practice surgery for village and the surrounding area. Includes details of doctors, services, open hours and dispensary.

links.title: Wikipedia: Yetminster
links.description: Article describing the village, its history, amenities and notable people, with references and related links.

links.title: Barfoot's Bouncers
links.description: Bouncy castle hire, and inflatable such as Sumo suit rental. Provides photographs, details of their product and delivery range, FAQ, terms, testimonials and contacts.

links.title: St Andrew's Primary School
links.description: Class pages, details of school clubs, examples of pupils' work, events diary, and school prospectus.

links.title: Online Parish Clerk: Yetminster
links.description: Historical details of the village inhabitants, including forename, surname, age, and occupation and other parish information.

links.title: Yetminster, Ryme Intrinseca & Hamlet
links.description: Parish Council information includes visitor, business and local organisation details, with planning, notices, meeting minutes and agendas.

508558.title: East Riding of Yorkshire
508558.description: <dl><dt>This category leads specifically to websites providing information on the ceremonial county of the East Riding of Yorkshire.</dt><dd>which comprises the two unitary authorities of Hull and East Riding of Yorkshire Councils.</dd><dt>East Yorkshire includes the following towns:</dt><dd>Beverley, Bridlington, Driffield, Goole, Hedon, Hessle, Hornsea, Howden, Market Weighton, Pocklington, Snaith and Cowick, Weighton</dd><dd>and 156 parishes.</dd></dl>

links.title: Airmyn Park Primary School
links.description: Small school with just over hundred pupils located in Airmyn 2 miles north west of Goole. Contains school details, staff, curriculum details and links.

508608.title: Aldbrough
508608.description:
Aldbrough is a parish on the east coast of the East Riding of Yorkshire, between
  Roos to the south,  Sproatley further inland and  Mapleton further north.
The village of Aldbrough is set back a mile from the cliffs and Aldbrough sands, and the hamlet of East Newton.
This category includes websites for the parishes of East Garton to the south, Humbleton and Burton Constable inland,
Withernwick to the north west, before Mappleton to the north.

links.title: Aldborough Sundial
links.description: Historical information about the sundial.

links.title: BBC News: Aldbrough Primary School League Table
links.description: Full school league table information for Aldbrough Primary School, Hull.

508671.title: Anlaby
508671.description:
This category lists websites for the East Riding of Yorkshire parish of Anlaby with Anlaby Common.
Anlaby is a conurbation west of the Hull boundary, north of  Hessle,
east of Kirk Ella and south of  Willerby.
Until there are sufficient websites for a separate category, this category also represents Kirk Ella.
but those for West Ella and around the A614 should be listed in the Willerby category.

links.title: Anlaby Park Methodist Church
links.description: An all-age evangelical church. Mission statement, weekly programme, links and church location information.

links.title: Ganton School
links.description: Mixed community special ages 3-19. Includes details of school, special teaching unit, meals and news.

links.title: Fraser Vehicle Repair Centre
links.description: Offers repairs, air conditioning servicing and wheel alignment. Profile and services with gallery.

links.title: Fields of Anlaby
links.description: Butchers and deli offering locally sourced meat, home made pies, cakes and pastries. Includes priofile, products, services, online sales and contacts.

links.title: Anlaby Surgery
links.description: NHS services. Provides information on doctors and staff, appointments, prescriptions, opening hours and contact information.

links.title: Yorkshire Vasectomy Reversal Clinic
links.description: Specialise in microsurgical vasectomy reversals. Site includes information on the reversal operation, success rates, surgeons, FAQs, contact information and consultation booking form.

508667.title: Arts and Entertainment
508667.description:
This category leads specifically to websites providing information on the arts and entertainment available within the East Riding of Yorkshire.
 
In order to see all the East Yorkshire localities with information for Arts and Entertainment,
try the  Regional Tree View

508669.title: Music
508669.description: This category includes sites about musicians, music schools, tuition, groups and events.

links.title: The East Yorkshire Motor Services Brass Band
links.description: News, events, contest results, history, photographs and links.

508670.title: Photography
508670.description: Examples of sites in this category may include photographers (both recreational and commercial) and photography clubs.

508682.title: Bempton
508682.description:
Bempton is a parish on the northern tip of the East Riding of Yorkshire, east of  Flamborough,
and north of  Bridlington.
Directly west is the boundary of the North Yorkshire's  Scarborough Borough.
This category includes websites for the area inland across the A165
to the East Yorkshire parishes of Grindale and Boyton.

links.title: Heritage Escapes
links.description: Offer a selection of farm cottages and pods, set on a working farm close to Bempton R.S.P.B Bird Reserve, Sewerby. Includes directions, pricing information and contact details.

links.title: Ako's Bed & Breakfast
links.description: Details of the facilities and pictures together with locality map.

links.title: Walmsley House
links.description: Holiday let sleeping up to 12. Profile, facilities, local attractions and reservations.

links.title: Bempton Primary School
links.description: Community school ages 5-11. Includes School Policies, curriculum, gallery and contact.

links.title: ST Gowan
links.description: An independent family business specialising in the sale, repair and servicing of agricultural machinery.

508721.title: Beverley
508721.description:
This category lists websites for the East Riding of Yorkshire's county town of Beverley.
Beverley Minster lacks cathedral status, so Beverley is a civil parish, rather than a city.
Beverley is 8 miles north west of the more populated  Hull City.
separated by  Woodmansey on A1174,
  Skidby and  Cottinginham south on the A164.

links.title: Beverley Beck
links.description: A canal which flows from the River Hull near to the centre of the historic town of Beverley. Includes pictures, scenes of the Beck and general information.

links.title: Dr. Mixer & Partners
links.description: Online appointment booking is available on the site. Also, updates about the practice and the services offered. The Old Fire Station Doctors Surgery in Beverley.

508724.title: Arts and Entertainment
508724.description: This category includes sites about artistic, cultural and entertainment activities, events, institutions, businesses and organisations in Beverley.

links.title: Beverley and District Ringing Society
links.description: History with details of meetings, towers, training days and contacts.

links.title: Beverley Musical Theatre
links.description: Performs musical shows, pantomimes and concerts. Details of productions, auditions and rehearsal schedules.

links.title: East Riding County Choir
links.description: One hundred and thirty mixed voices combine each year to perform two concerts in Beverley Minster, a historic church based right in the heart of the town centre. The official website offers information about the choir, the people involved with the choir, upcoming performances and also provides the public with an opportunity to buy tickets.

links.title: Beverley Folk Festival
links.description: Details of artists, programme, street shows, and craft fair. Also information on workshops and sessions running through the year. (in June, annually)

508727.title: Business and Economy
508727.description: This category includes sites covering the business and economic activities of Beverley, including listings of most companies and industries.

links.title: Norwood Veterinary Group
links.description: Local veterinary practice catering for all small and large domestic and farm animals. List of services, map and contact information.

links.title: Gray Deliver Ltd
links.description: Offers haulage, warehousing, distribution and a removal service throughout Yorkshire, the UK and Europe. Includes contact and service information.

links.title: ABI (UK) Ltd
links.description: Manufacturers of caravans and holiday homes. Detail of range with pictures plus list of dealers.

links.title: Foster Sales Co
links.description: Agricultural machinery sales both new and used. Includes catalogue and contact details.

links.title: Stanifords
links.description: Estate agents, chartered surveyors and auctioneers. Includes location profiles and searchable database of available properties.

links.title: NEMHS - North of England Medical and Hyperbaric Services
links.description: Private ambulance service providing transport and event coverage. Details of the company, picture gallery and contact information.

links.title: BNI Beverley
links.description: Business networking and referrals service. Current members, meeting locations, events and contact details.

links.title: Hill Top Caravan Storage
links.description: Secure caravan storage in Molescroft. Indoor and outdoor storage on hardstanding. Monthly and annual contracts.

links.title: Bob Trice Mechanics
links.description: Offers car servicing, repairs and MoTs. Profile and services. [Tickton]

links.title: Beverley and District Chamber of Trade
links.description: Gives business owners the opportunity to improve brand awareness whilst letting the public find a specialist in an area of need.

links.title: Train4Academy Ltd.
links.description: Offering compliant training for food hygiene certificate, available at level 1 and 2. Presents services including accredited online courses.

links.title: Finnies Accountants Limited
links.description: Based in Walkinton just outside of Beverley is a accounts for businesses in Beverley and surrounding areas. They are a chartered certified accountants with a host of clients across various industries. Offers financial news to advice on handling money.

links.title: East Riding Business Centre
links.description: Run by the council in the East Riding of Yorkshire. The centre gives information to business owners and entrepreneurs on everything they need to know about running a business, from trading standards to opportunities for businesses to work with the council.

links.title: Just Beverley
links.description: Online and offline publication at the heart of promoting local businesses in the Beverley area. The publication focuses on bringing organisations in Beverley to the forefront of people's minds. Whether it may be a local school who's done something newsworthy or a local construction company, Works to help share businesses' successes with the internet and magazine readers.

508731.title: Computers and Internet
508731.description: This category lists business sites related to computers and the Internet, such as Internet service providers, web design and hosting services, e-commerce developers, network consulting services, companies supplying computers, computer repair and support services, software developers and consultants located in Beverley.

links.title: Indicoll
links.description: Search engine optimisation, web design, social media marketing and development of web apps.

links.title: Computer Support - Beverley
links.description: A local, family-run business providing comprehensive technical support to the Beverley area for 10 years.

links.title: Saxon Computing
links.description: Custom software development, bespoke software design, web site design, networking, WAN, EPOS and support. Includes company profile, case studies and contact details.

508729.title: Construction and Maintenance
508729.description: This category contains links to companies engaged in the design and construction of buildings and other structures, heavy construction, architects, engineers, builders, contractors, designers, material suppliers, plant and equipment, surveyors, cleaning and civil engineering It also contains links to associated trades such as bricklayers and tilers, carpentry and joinery, concreters, excavation, electrical, painters, plasterers and finishers, heat, air and fire control system installers, plumbing, drainage and shop fitters.

links.title: Bankside Patterson Limited
